Thanks for the clear recap, Olivia — great to meet the LedgerLabs team. Below is a concise answer to the procurement and unit-economics questions, plus a recommended PO/contract path given your $15k/month internal PO threshold.

1) Unit economics (approximate) — pilot (30M tokens/month) vs committed band (150M/month)
- Pilot (no commit, hosted): $/1M tokens ~ $1,100 — estimated monthly spend ~ $33k. This uses standard hosted profile with minimal caching.
- Committed 6–12 month band (150M tokens/month): $/1M tokens ~ $650 — estimated monthly spend ~ $97.5k. Includes modest batching settings and a 10% multi-month commit discount.
- Notes: those figures assume typical mix (short:long = 95:5) and no heavy embedding usage. If you enable aggressive prefix caching on customer-specific prompts the pilot effective cost could drop ~10–20%.

2) Procurement / PO thresholds and recommended path
- Since your internal PO threshold is $15k/mo, pilot at 30M (~$33k/mo) exceeds that. Two pragmatic options: 
  a) Reduce pilot footprint (test a 10–15M token pilot) to stay under PO threshold, OR
  b) Proceed with a standard purchase order + our short-term (60-day) Master Services Agreement (MSA-lite) to satisfy your legal team. Redwood can accept a customer PO; we require an MSA for commitments above $25k/mo for recurring accounting reasons.
- Lead times: PO only + onboarding = ~2 weeks. PO + MSA review = 3–5 weeks depending on legal back-and-forth.

3) Recommended approach for LedgerLabs
- If LedgerLabs wants realistic pilot telemetry at scale, I recommend option (b) — submit PO + sign MSA-lite. That preserves the telemetry you need and avoids an artificially small pilot. We can set a 60-day checkpoint to revisit commit economics.

4) Immediate asks / next steps
- Olivia: confirm whether finance prefers a reduced pilot (<$15k/mo) or to move forward with PO + MSA-lite.
- If PO path: please share the PO contact and a preferred PO template. We’ll attach a compact MSA and an onboarding checklist.

Attachments: forecast_token_profile.csv (sample token mix + estimated spend)

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0119
